adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then applies them directly to `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no upper bound or validation. This allows arbitrarily large `limit` values (potentially dumping/serializing huge membership lists) and allows negative offsets/limits (e.g. `-1`) to flow into the DB call, which can cause errors or unintended behavior.
